_comment: Hand-curated references for Hannibal detection rules. Technique IDs are checked against the loaded ATT&CK bundle at build time; anything not found is reported, never invented.

R-CANARY.summary: Decoy file or decoy credential touched

R-INDICATOR.summary: Exact SHA-256 match with a signed indicator bundle

R-PERSIST-UNTRUSTED.summary: Persistence change by a process without a trusted signature

R-LINEAGE-EGRESS.summary: Outbound connection by a lineage under investigation

R-ML-ANOMALY.summary: Behavioral ranking signal; not a technique attribution
